targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly_drives AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', d.started_at) AS month,
    d.vehicle_id,
    COUNT(*) AS drives,
    ROUND(convert_distance(SUM((d.distance_m / 1609.344)))::numeric, 1) AS distance_km,
    ROUND(SUM((d.duration_s / 60.0))::numeric) AS duration_min,
    ROUND(convert_speed(SUM((d.distance_m / 1609.344)) / NULLIF(SUM((d.duration_s / 60.0)), 0) * 60)::numeric, 1) AS avg_speed,
    ROUND(convert_speed(MAX((d.max_speed_mps * 2.2369362920544)))::numeric) AS top_speed
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', d.started_at), d.vehicle_id
),
monthly_charges AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', cs.started_at) AS month,
    cs.vehicle_id,
    COUNT(*) AS charges,
    ROUND(SUM((cs.total_energy_added_wh / 1000.0))::numeric, 1) AS energy_kwh,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cost_decimal IS NOT NULL THEN cs.cost_decimal END)::numeric, 2) AS cost
  FROM charging_sessions cs
  WHERE cs.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', cs.started_at), cs.vehicle_id
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(md.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS "📅 Month",
  md.drives AS "🛣️ Drives",
  md.distance_km AS "📏 Distance",
  md.duration_min AS "⏱️ Duration",
  md.avg_speed AS "🚗 Avg Speed",
  md.top_speed AS "🏎️ Top Speed",
  COALESCE(mc.charges, 0) AS "⚡ Charges",
  mc.energy_kwh AS "⚡ Energy",
  mc.cost AS "💰 Cost"
FROM monthly_drives md
LEFT JOIN monthly_charges mc ON mc.month = md.month AND mc.vehicle_id = md.vehicle_id
ORDER BY md.month DESC
